1 finding (0 block, 1 wrong, 0 rough) in 14 actions

## Charter
- https://shop.example/, "the checkout with odd quantities", 9 minutes.

## Found
- wrong — 1. Open Blue mug. 2. Set quantity to −1. 3. Add. — saw: the basket shows "−1 × Blue mug, −£12.00", total −£12.00 — expected: the quantity refused or clamped to 1 — screen: "Basket — 1 line: '−1 × Blue mug, −£12.00'; total −£12.00."

## Tried
- Quantity 0: refused with "Choose at least 1". Held.
- Quantity 999999: clamped to 99 with "Up to 99 per order". Held.

## Not reached
- Pay with a card: not attempted; no real payment.
- Back after submit, double Add: time budget spent on the quantity probes.

script.say:
1 finding: a negative quantity makes a negative total (wrong); 0 and 999999 held.

## Report
- 14 actions on shop.example; wrote "Exploratory session — the checkout with odd quantities"
